name: X (Twitter)
description: Post tweets with an image, reply to tweets, read your own posts with their engagement, and search recent tweets.

providedTools.description: Post a tweet, optionally with one image. Pass reply_to_tweet_id (the numeric id of an existing tweet) to post it as a REPLY to that tweet instead of a standalone post — X has no separate reply endpoint, a reply is a tweet that names its parent. To attach a picture, pass image_file_id: the id returned by make_image. Always pass image_alt with it. If the image cannot be uploaded the text is still published and image_skipped says why, so check image_attached before reporting that a picture went out.

Your own recent posts with their engagement counts (likes, replies, reposts, views). This is the only way to learn how a post performed. Every call is billed by X, so read on a schedule rather than on every run.
Search recent public tweets. Returns each tweet's id, which is what reply_to_tweet_id takes. Billed by X per call.
